purpose: Audit overlapping MoonPet Saved Status claim authorities against /player/action-plan. Gaps are explicit and must not inflate My Moonboy claim badges.

mappings.notes: Account claim authority preserves original earning pet/day through source_pet_ref; only verified claim_ready rows count.
Original pet/session remains authoritative after selected-pet changes.
Dashboard uses saved activity source/read status; recovery rows remain source-bound and do not replay writes.
Only canonical completed unpaid bounty authority can become claim_ready; internal recovery reservations are excluded.
Verified source-pet reward rows are represented; action-plan projection remains bounded and source-status aware.
No dedicated action-plan cache adapter exists on this baseline. My Moonboy must not invent a cache claim badge.
No dedicated season-tier claim adapter exists on this baseline. Saved Status remains canonical for this claim class.
Daily/Weekly Journey awards settle automatically; readiness is progress/settlement state, not an extra claim badge.
Evolution is an upgrade/review path, not a payout claim.
MoonPet Saved Status exposes unclaimed Finale rewards, but the current action-plan registry has no dedicated Finale claim adapter. Do not add these to My Moonboy claim badges.
Extra daily challenge claims are distinct from ordinary daily bounties. The current moonpet.claimable-rewards adapter does not project this bonus board.
Weekly bounty block claims have their own Saved Status authority and are not represented by the ordinary daily bounty action-plan adapter.
